**PIB Fact Check (Press Information Bureau)**
*Title:* Post debunking 3 months free mobile recharge claim
*Date:* September 3, 2026 [1]
*Claim ID:* c1
The official fact-checking unit of the Government of India, PIB Fact Check, stated that the viral claim alleging Prime Minister Narendra Modi is providing 3 months of free mobile recharge to all Indian users is completely fake [1]. It clarified that no such scheme is being operated by Prime Minister Modi or the Government of India, and warned citizens against falling for such scams or sharing malicious links [2] [1].

**TV9 Hindi**
*Title:* PM मोदी के नाम से 3 महीने के फ्री मोबाइल रिचार्ज का दावा वायरल है [3]
*Date:* September 4, 2026 [3]
*Claim ID:* c1
The outlet reported on the viral message falsely asserting that PM Modi is distributing three months of free recharge to Indian users [3]. It noted that the government has not initiated any such scheme and highlighted PIB's warning advising users to beware of deceptive messages and suspicious links [3].

**ET Now**
*Title:* PM Modi offering 3 months of free mobile recharge? PIB Fact Check debunks viral claim - Check details [2]
*Date:* September 5, 2026 [2]
*Claim ID:* c1
The report details an online scam using images of Prime Minister Narendra Modi promising 3 months of free mobile recharge across telecom networks including Jio, Airtel, Vodafone, and BSNL [2]. It reports that the Prime Minister and the Indian government have no connection to the scheme, and experts warned that the fraudulent links are designed for phishing and data theft [2] [4].

**NDTV / Factly**
*Title:* Fact Check: Is PM Modi Giving 3 Months Free Recharge To Celebrate 2024 Election Win? [4]
*Date:* June 7, 2024 [4]
*Claim ID:* c1
Investigating widespread social media posts claiming PM Modi was offering 3 months of free mobile recharge, the fact-check found that no such scheme was ever announced by Modi or the BJP [4]. It cited police and government alerts explaining that the circulating links lead to fraudulent websites used by cybercriminals to collect personal data [4].
